method: Native photograph coordinates picked before reading either whole mesh. All rows stay fixed for first and revised versions. Distinct from the coplanar camera calibration points. Reporting exact first-hit and circular pixel tolerance.
material_class_for_gap: The first hit must be behind the front parapet, or pass beyond the photographed bay. Ground guards, laundry and a satellite dish are omitted from check points.
